title: Wave motion and language
design_rationale: Build a physical model of progressive waves before measurement or equations.
concepts_taught: Use ropes, springs and ripple tanks to distinguish travelling disturbance from material transport.
Explain that progressive waves transfer energy while particles oscillate about equilibrium.
Distinguish displacement, amplitude, period, frequency, wavelength and speed.
Read phase difference from spatial and temporal wave representations.

next_module_can_assume: Use ropes, springs and ripple tanks to distinguish travelling disturbance from material transport.
Explain that progressive waves transfer energy while particles oscillate about equilibrium.
Distinguish displacement, amplitude, period, frequency, wavelength and speed.
Read phase difference from spatial and temporal wave representations.
next_module_must_not_assume: Use y-gain to determine signal amplitude.
